SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.title: Shuten Douji
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.description: Distill Poison into Sake, cross Assassin and Caster styles, and choose one of two Noble Phantasms.
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.goldMonologue: Antiques, poison, and a lovely cup. Gold can arrange all three.
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.eventDeathPrevention: The banquet is not over while the oni still smiles.
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.aromaPrinciple: Every sweet aroma hides a sharper finish.
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.cardsModifierDescript: Play with Shuten Douji's card pool.
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.banter.alive.endTurnP: Drink slowly. The last cup is the dangerous one.
SHUTENDOUJI-SHUTEN.banter.dead.endTurnPi: Do not leave the banquet unfinished.
